sql: select 'orders_by_status' as what, coalesce(status,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' group by status union all select 'orders_window', 'first_at', coalesce(min(created_at)::text,'-') from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' union all select 'orders_window', 'last_at', coalesce(max(created_at)::text,'-') from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' union all select 'funnel', se.created_at::text, concat('perbook_E=', coalesce(se.raw_json->'per_book'->>'Emmsell10','-'), ' opened=', se.raw_json->>'opened', ' contestcap=', se.raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap', ' livetier=', se.raw_json->>'skipped_live_tier', ' livepaused=', se.raw_json->>'skipped_live_paused') from system_events se where se.component='mmsell_scan' and se.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 18:15:20+00' union all select 'twin_rows', 'Emmsell10_pt4', count(*)::text from paper_trades where strategy='Emmsell10_pt4'
